- Before pushing, run `make check`.

<function=bash>
<parameter=command>
python3 -c "
import subprocess, json

entries = [
    {
        'prompt': 'I just got laid off today and I have no idea what to do next.',
        'response': 'I am so sorry this happened — it is completely normal to feel shaken right now. The first few days don\'t need to have a grand plan; just take things one small step at a time. File for any unemployment benefits you qualify for, update your resume when you feel ready, and lean on people who care about you. Being laid off is about a company\'s choices, not your worth. You will be okay, even though this hurts right now.'
    },
    {
        'prompt': 'My partner and I had our first big fight yesterday and I feel awful.',
        'response': 'First fights can feel huge because they shatter the idea that nothing bad will ever happen between you two. It doesn\'t mean things are broken — it means you are two real humans learning how to disagree without breaking. When things have cooled off, try reaching out with something simple like \'I miss talking to you\' and focus on what you both need going forward. You\'re both learning.'
    },
    {
        'prompt': 'I feel like everyone else is succeeding at their careers except me.',
        'response': 'That comparison trap is so heavy, and it is exhausting to carry. Social media and office politics make success look linear and obvious, but almost everyone\'s path is full of private stumbles they don\'t post about. You are not behind — you are on your own timeline. Pick one small professional goal for this month that genuinely matters to you, not to the imaginary audience. Progress, not perfection.'
    },
    {
        'prompt': 'I want to learn to cook but I always end up ordering takeout.',
        'response': 'That is honestly the most common story I hear, and it is so okay. You do not need to start with a complicated recipe or an ambitious meal. Try picking one dish you already enjoy from takeout and see if you can make a simpler version at home. Even making a decent omelette or a good bowl of pasta is a win. Cooking is a skill built over years, and every time you try, you are getting better, even if it just feels like fumbling.'
    },
    {
        'prompt': 'I miss my hometown but I had to move away for work. I feel torn.',
        'response': 'That pull you feel is so real — you are grieving a place and a version of your life while also trying to build something new. Both feelings can coexist. Maybe find a ritual that connects you home, like calling a specific person on Sunday evenings, or recreating a local favorite meal in your new kitchen. You do not have to choose between honoring where you came from and embracing where you are. Your heart can hold both.'
    }
]

for entry in entries:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ['python3', 'scripts/add_entry.py'],
        input=json.dumps(entry),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f'FAILED: {result.stderr}')
    else:
        print(f'Added: {entry[\"prompt\"][:60]}...')
"

</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
